comment: Twin of fluctuator_drawn_land_casts_stinger.json with the draw order reversed: the chain draws Drannith Stinger FIRST (uncastable: no red, the drop not yet useful) and Capital City SECOND. Only the LAND draw can open the re-solve here -- MTG_FLUCT_DRAWN_LAND's land-draw trigger (the drawn untapped land makes a held card castable through the open drop). T3 kill.
